title: Consultation
description: Personalised Ayurvedic consultation with Dr. Megha K S. Conditions treated include joint pain, back ache, skin diseases, metabolic disorders, and menstrual health — tailored to your body constitution (Prakriti).

title: Panchakarma
description: Ayurveda's premier detoxification therapy — five classical purification procedures including Vamana, Virechana, Basti, Nasya, and Raktamokshana. Deeply cleanses accumulated toxins and restores doshic balance.

title: Shirodhara
description: A continuous stream of warm medicated oil flows over the forehead, deeply calming the nervous system. Highly effective for insomnia, chronic stress, anxiety, migraine, and hypertension.

title: Swarnaprashana
description: Classical Ayurvedic gold immunisation for children from birth to 16 years. Given on Pushya Nakshatra each month. Boosts immunity, enhances memory and cognitive development. No appointment needed.

title: Abhyanga & Steam
description: Full-body medicated oil massage followed by herbal steam therapy. Nourishes tissues, improves circulation, reduces muscle stiffness, and prepares the body for deeper Panchakarma therapies.

title: Udwartana
description: Therapeutic dry powder massage using herbal powders. Stimulates fat metabolism, improves lymphatic drainage, and is particularly effective for weight management and reducing subcutaneous fat.

title: Pinda Sweda
description: Bolus massage using bundles of herbal leaves or medicated rice (Navarakizhi). Highly effective for joint pain, arthritis, sports injuries, and neuromuscular conditions.

title: Women's Health
description: Specialised Ayurvedic care for PCOD/PCOS, menstrual irregularities, hormonal imbalances, and fertility support. Uttara Basti and classical herbal formulations for lasting results.

title: Skin Disorders
description: Internal detoxification-led treatment for psoriasis, eczema, acne, and pigmentation. Virechana and Takra Dhara address the root cause rather than suppressing symptoms.
